mentions.name: Software house
mentions.description: A coding-agent platform the author calls a "software house": Codex/Claude running on a VPS with a web interface, able to build and publish software and web apps. It grew out of wanting to build and test a Pebble watch app idea on the spot, and is planned to be open sourced.
mentions.problem: The author wanted to build and test an app idea on the spot without setting up Codex against git repos in the cloud, whose usage allowances felt less generous.
mentions.source_excerpt: Inbetween that I've been working on a "software house" (don't know how else to describe it). Pretty much codex/claude running on a VPS with a web interface and the ability to actually build and publish software / webapps etc.
